g.text: Welch panel, 48 h, standard Wnt: the 50 genes of highest deviance share, ordered by clustering of the pooled within-type correlation (average linkage on 1 − |r|).
Diagonal (grey) set to 1. Columns: sample correlation, then the levels chosen by the bulk likelihood (common) and by held-out cells (per type, in the row label).
Shrinkage multiplies every off-diagonal correlation by 1 − λ: the pattern stays, its contrast fades
